items.sentence: What remains to be seen is whether an AI can invent a financial instrument at all. Harari asserts that anything made of words will be taken over, but that’s a big if for money. Provided that many firms run one model, a single point of failure appears, and a shock can amplify in a feedback loop. Don’t conflate volume with opacity: rarity is by no means the same thing. Correlation cuts both ways. Don’t read too much into a toy, with the caveat that it shows what could happen, not what will.
